name: Gasthof Wilder Kaiser
beschreibung: The Gasthof Wilder Kaiser is located in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser in Tirol. The house offers guest rooms and a traditional parlour. The kitchen serves regional specialties from Tirol. The Gasthof lies amid the mountain landscape of the Wilder Kaiser. The building has an Alpine country style. It is suitable as a starting point for hikes and ski tours. The business is family-run. The furnishings are rustic and cozy.
